subject: Human Body
title: Oxytocin: The Bonding Hormone
description: A short lesson to help you apply Oxytocin: The Bonding Hormone.

hook.text: A mother holds her newborn and a hormone floods her brain. Oxytocin creates the bond between parent and child.

buildup.text: Oxytocin is released during hugging, breastfeeding, and social bonding. It promotes trust and emotional connection.

discovery.text: It also triggers uterine contractions during birth and milk release during breastfeeding. Same hormone, multiple roles.

twist.text: Oxytocin can increase in-group favoritism and out-group hostility. The 'love hormone' also fuels tribalism.

climax.text: Oxytocin bonds families, couples, and communities. But its bias toward 'us' can also deepen divisions with 'them.'

punchline.text: The love hormone also picks sides. Bonding has a dark edge.

quiz.question: What is a lesser-known effect of oxytocin?
options: It slows heart rate during exercise
It can increase in-group bias and out-group hostility
It suppresses appetite during social events
